"""What an agent really did on its website, and the gate that reads it before a question is closed.

A model that says "I searched everywhere" proves nothing. The agent loop writes this record itself, from the actions
it carried out: the pages it opened, the text it typed into search and filter fields, the lists it followed and how
each of them ended. Closing a question is then checked against the record:

- a list that stopped at its page limit while its paging control was still there is incomplete, so no question is
  closed on this website until the rest is read;
- "absent" is the one claim the case file cannot check, so it is answered with the record first: a search without
  hits covers that search term in that place and nothing more.

Every refusal is bounded. After `LIMIT` of them a question closes anyway: the gate may cost an agent a few turns,
it must never keep a run from finishing. Nothing here knows a website; where to look next stays the model's call.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from urllib.parse import urlparse

LIMIT = 2  # refusals per question
SHOWN = 12  # entries of each kind in the record an agent is shown


@dataclass
class ListRun:
    where: str  # the address the list was followed from
    control: str  # the label of the paging control
    pages: int
    capped: bool  # it stopped at the page limit and the control was still there


def _short(address: str) -> str:
    """An address without its host: the agent works one website."""
    parts = urlparse(address)
    return (parts.path or "/") + (f"?{parts.query}" if parts.query else "") + (f"#{parts.fragment}" if parts.fragment else "")


class Ledger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.views: dict[str, str] = {}  # address -> title, in the order of the first visit
        self.queries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []  # (address, text typed), each once
        self.lists: list[ListRun] = []
        self.moves = 0  # browser actions that visibly changed the page
        self.refused: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}  # question -> (refusals so far, size of the record at the last)

    # ---- written by the agent loop ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def saw(self, page: str) -> None:
        """A page as the agent read it: its first lines carry the address and the title."""
        address = re.match(r"url: (\S+)", page or "")
        if address and address.group(1) not in self.views:
            title = re.search(r"^title: (.*)$", page, re.M)
            self.views[address.group(1)] = title.group(1).strip()[:60] if title else ""

    def typed(self, where: str, text) -> None:
        text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        if text and (where, text.casefold()) not in {(place, query.casefold()) for place, query in self.queries}:
            self.queries.append((where, text))

    def followed(self, run: dict | None) -> None:
        """How `Tab.collect` ended (its `last_collect`)."""
        if run:
            self.lists.append(ListRun(str(run.get("where", "")), str(run.get("control", "")),
                                      int(run.get("pages") or 0), bool(run.get("capped"))))

    def moved(self) -> None:
        self.moves += 1

    # ---- read by the gate ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def size(self) -> int:
        return len(self.views) + len(self.queries) + len(self.lists) + self.moves

    def incomplete(self) -> list[ListRun]:
        """Lists whose last run stopped at the page limit. Following the same control to its end clears it."""
        latest: dict[str, ListRun] = {}
        for run in self.lists:
            latest[run.control] = run
        return [run for run in latest.values() if run.capped]

    def report(self) -> str:
        pages = [f'"{title}" {_short(address)}' if title else _short(address) for address, title in self.views.items()]
        typed = [f'"{text[:60]}" at {_short(where)}' for where, text in self.queries]
        lists = [f'"{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)}: {run.pages} page(s), '
                 + ("STOPPED AT THE PAGE LIMIT" if run.capped else "to the end") for run in self.lists]
        return "\n".join(f"- {label} ({len(items)}): " + ("; ".join(items[-SHOWN:]) or "none") for label, items in (
            ("pages opened", pages), ("text typed into search and other fields", typed),
            ("lists followed page by page", lists)))

    def gate(self, question: str, status: str) -> str | None:
        """None when the question may be closed as `status`, else what is missing."""
        times, size = self.refused.get(question, (0, -1))
        if times >= LIMIT:
            return None
        cut_short = self.incomplete()
        if cut_short:
            self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
            return ("not closed: " + "; ".join(f'the list you followed with "{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)} '
                                               f"stopped at its limit of {run.pages} page(s) with more pages left"
                                               for run in cut_short)
                    + ". An incomplete list proves neither that everything is filed nor that something is absent. "
                      "Collect the rest (collect continues from the page you are on; a higher max_pages reads "
                      "further), file it with keep, then answer again.")
        if status != "absent" or (times and self.size() > size):
            return None
        self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
        lead = "not closed: nothing new was searched since the last check. " if times else "not closed yet. "
        return (lead + "Absent needs a full search, and this is what you actually did on this website:\n"
                + self.report()
                + "\nA search without hits covers only that search term in that place. Before you answer absent "
                  "again: open every section, folder or list of this website that could hold it and is not in the "
                  "record, search with another term from the case file (an identifier, a shorter form, a "
                  "describing word), and follow paged lists to their end. If the record already covers all of "
                  "that, make one more different search to confirm, then answer again.")
        for frame in self.page.frames:
            try:
                outcome = await frame.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, [self.credentials.get("username", ""), self.credentials["password"]])
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                continue
            if outcome == "ok":
                await frame.locator("[data-login-password]").first.press("Enter")
                await self.settle()
                return f"entered the credentials and submitted the login form; now at {self.page.url}"
        return outcome

    async def collect(self, aid, max_pages: int = 10) -> str:
        """Follow the paging control the model chose until it is gone, and return every page as one document.
        `last_collect` records how it ended: a list that stopped at the page limit with its control still there is
        not complete, and the answer says so instead of passing for the whole list."""
        self.last_collect = None
        locator = self._locator(aid)
        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
        info = await self._describe(locator)
        if not info["name"]:
            return f"[{aid}] has no label to follow from page to page"
        first, start = self.document, self.page.url
        pages, seen = [first], {first}
        limit = max(1, min(int(max_pages or 10), 30))

        async def next_control():
            for _, _, frame in self.frames:
                candidates = frame.locator("a[href], button, [role=button], [role=link]")
                for index in range(min(await candidates.count(), 200)):
                    candidate = candidates.nth(index)
                    try:
                        label = clean_text(await candidate.evaluate("el => el.innerText || el.value || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || ''"))[:80]
                        if label == info["name"] and (await candidate.evaluate("el => el.tagName")) == info["tag"] \
                                and not await candidate.evaluate(
                                    "el => el.disabled === true || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true'"):
                            return candidate
                    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                        continue
            return None

        capped = False
        for turn in range(limit):
            control = await next_control()
            if control is None:
                break
            if turn == limit - 1:  # the page limit ended this, not the list: the control is still there
                capped = True
                break
            try:
                await control.click(timeout=2500)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                try:
                    await control.evaluate("el => el.click()")
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    break
            await self.read()
            if self.document in seen:
                break
            seen.add(self.document)
            pages.append(self.document)
        self.last_collect = {"where": start, "control": info["name"], "pages": len(pages), "capped": capped}
        more = (f' THE LIST IS NOT COMPLETE: this stopped at the limit of {limit} page(s) and "{info["name"]}" is '
                "still there. Collect again from this page (a higher max_pages reads further) before you treat the "
                "list as complete." if capped else "")
        if len(pages) == 1:
            return (f"max_pages {limit} reads only the page you see." + more if capped
                    else f'"{info["name"]}" led to no further page; the list is the page you see')
        # A button may append rows in place rather than lead to a new page. Compare page bodies without generated
        # element ids or the changing paging control: both change between reads even when every earlier row remains.
        def body(page: str) -> str:
            return "\n".join(line for line in without_ids(page).splitlines()
                             if not re.match(r'(?:button|link) "', line.strip()))

        bodies = [body(page) for page in pages]
        grows = (len(pages) > 1 and info["tag"].upper() != "A"
                 and all(later.startswith(earlier) and len(later) >= len(earlier)
                         for earlier, later in zip(bodies, bodies[1:])))
        if grows:  # a "load more" control: the last page holds every row
            self.document = pages[-1]
            return (f'followed "{info["name"]}" {len(pages) - 1} time(s); '
                    + ("the rows loaded so far are on the page." + more if capped
                       else "the list is now complete on the page"))
        self.document = "\n".join(f"{PAGE_BREAK} {number} =====\n{page}" for number, page in enumerate(pages, 1))
        return (f'followed "{info["name"]}" through {len(pages)} page(s); you are on the last one.{more} COLLECTED '
                f"DOCUMENT (file it with keep if it is relevant):\n{without_ids(self.document)[:MAX_OBSERVATION * 2]}")

"""What an agent really did on its website, and the gate that reads it before a question is closed.

A model that says "I searched everywhere" proves nothing. The agent loop writes this record itself, from the actions
it carried out: the pages it opened, the text it typed into search and filter fields, the lists it followed and how
each of them ended. Closing a question is then checked against the record:

- a list that stopped at its page limit while its paging control was still there is incomplete, so no question is
  closed on this website until the rest is read;
- "absent" is the one claim the case file cannot check, so it is answered with the record first: a search without
  hits covers that search term in that place and nothing more.

Every refusal is bounded. After `LIMIT` of them a question closes anyway: the gate may cost an agent a few turns,
it must never keep a run from finishing. Nothing here knows a website; where to look next stays the model's call.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from urllib.parse import urlparse

LIMIT = 2  # refusals per question
SHOWN = 12  # entries of each kind in the record an agent is shown


@dataclass
class ListRun:
    where: str  # the address the list was followed from
    control: str  # the label of the paging control
    pages: int
    capped: bool  # it stopped at the page limit and the control was still there


def _short(address: str) -> str:
    """An address without its host: the agent works one website."""
    parts = urlparse(address)
    return (parts.path or "/") + (f"?{parts.query}" if parts.query else "") + (f"#{parts.fragment}" if parts.fragment else "")


class Ledger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.views: dict[str, str] = {}  # address -> title, in the order of the first visit
        self.queries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []  # (address, text typed), each once
        self.lists: list[ListRun] = []
        self.moves = 0  # browser actions that visibly changed the page
        self.refused: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}  # question -> (refusals so far, size of the record at the last)

    # ---- written by the agent loop ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def saw(self, page: str) -> None:
        """A page as the agent read it: its first lines carry the address and the title."""
        address = re.match(r"url: (\S+)", page or "")
        if address and address.group(1) not in self.views:
            title = re.search(r"^title: (.*)$", page, re.M)
            self.views[address.group(1)] = title.group(1).strip()[:60] if title else ""

    def typed(self, where: str, text) -> None:
        text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        if text and (where, text.casefold()) not in {(place, query.casefold()) for place, query in self.queries}:
            self.queries.append((where, text))

    def followed(self, run: dict | None) -> None:
        """How `Tab.collect` ended (its `last_collect`)."""
        if run:
            self.lists.append(ListRun(str(run.get("where", "")), str(run.get("control", "")),
                                      int(run.get("pages") or 0), bool(run.get("capped"))))

    def moved(self) -> None:
        self.moves += 1

    # ---- read by the gate ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def size(self) -> int:
        return len(self.views) + len(self.queries) + len(self.lists) + self.moves

    def incomplete(self) -> list[ListRun]:
        """Lists whose last run stopped at the page limit. Following the same control to its end clears it."""
        latest: dict[str, ListRun] = {}
        for run in self.lists:
            latest[run.control] = run
        return [run for run in latest.values() if run.capped]

    def report(self) -> str:
        pages = [f'"{title}" {_short(address)}' if title else _short(address) for address, title in self.views.items()]
        typed = [f'"{text[:60]}" at {_short(where)}' for where, text in self.queries]
        lists = [f'"{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)}: {run.pages} page(s), '
                 + ("STOPPED AT THE PAGE LIMIT" if run.capped else "to the end") for run in self.lists]
        return "\n".join(f"- {label} ({len(items)}): " + ("; ".join(items[-SHOWN:]) or "none") for label, items in (
            ("pages opened", pages), ("text typed into search and other fields", typed),
            ("lists followed page by page", lists)))

    def gate(self, question: str, status: str) -> str | None:
        """None when the question may be closed as `status`, else what is missing."""
        times, size = self.refused.get(question, (0, -1))
        if times >= LIMIT:
            return None
        cut_short = self.incomplete()
        if cut_short:
            self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
            return ("not closed: " + "; ".join(f'the list you followed with "{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)} '
                                               f"stopped at its limit of {run.pages} page(s) with more pages left"
                                               for run in cut_short)
                    + ". An incomplete list proves neither that everything is filed nor that something is absent. "
                      "Collect the rest (collect continues from the page you are on; a higher max_pages reads "
                      "further), file it with keep, then answer again.")
        if status != "absent" or (times and self.size() > size):
            return None
        self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
        lead = "not closed: nothing new was searched since the last check. " if times else "not closed yet. "
        return (lead + "Absent needs a full search, and this is what you actually did on this website:\n"
                + self.report()
                + "\nA search without hits covers only that search term in that place. Before you answer absent "
                  "again: open every section, folder or list of this website that could hold it and is not in the "
                  "record, search with another term from the case file (an identifier, a shorter form, a "
                  "describing word), and follow paged lists to their end. If the record already covers all of "
                  "that, make one more different search to confirm, then answer again.")
        for frame in self.page.frames:
            try:
                outcome = await frame.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, [self.credentials.get("username", ""), self.credentials["password"]])
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                continue
            if outcome == "ok":
                await frame.locator("[data-login-password]").first.press("Enter")
                await self.settle()
                return f"entered the credentials and submitted the login form; now at {self.page.url}"
        return outcome

    async def collect(self, aid, max_pages: int = 10) -> str:
        """Follow the paging control the model chose until it is gone, and return every page as one document.
        `last_collect` records how it ended: a list that stopped at the page limit with its control still there is
        not complete, and the answer says so instead of passing for the whole list."""
        self.last_collect = None
        locator = self._locator(aid)
        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
        info = await self._describe(locator)
        if not info["name"]:
            return f"[{aid}] has no label to follow from page to page"
        first, start = self.document, self.page.url
        pages, seen = [first], {first}
        limit = max(1, min(int(max_pages or 10), 30))

        async def next_control():
            for _, _, frame in self.frames:
                candidates = frame.locator("a[href], button, [role=button], [role=link]")
                for index in range(min(await candidates.count(), 200)):
                    candidate = candidates.nth(index)
                    try:
                        label = clean_text(await candidate.evaluate("el => el.innerText || el.value || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || ''"))[:80]
                        if label == info["name"] and (await candidate.evaluate("el => el.tagName")) == info["tag"] \
                                and not await candidate.evaluate(
                                    "el => el.disabled === true || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true'"):
                            return candidate
                    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                        continue
            return None

        capped = False
        for turn in range(limit):
            control = await next_control()
            if control is None:
                break
            if turn == limit - 1:  # the page limit ended this, not the list: the control is still there
                capped = True
                break
            try:
                await control.click(timeout=2500)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                try:
                    await control.evaluate("el => el.click()")
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    break
            await self.read()
            if self.document in seen:
                break
            seen.add(self.document)
            pages.append(self.document)
        self.last_collect = {"where": start, "control": info["name"], "pages": len(pages), "capped": capped}
        more = (f' THE LIST IS NOT COMPLETE: this stopped at the limit of {limit} page(s) and "{info["name"]}" is '
                "still there. Collect again from this page (a higher max_pages reads further) before you treat the "
                "list as complete." if capped else "")
        if len(pages) == 1:
            return (f"max_pages {limit} reads only the page you see." + more if capped
                    else f'"{info["name"]}" led to no further page; the list is the page you see')
        # A button may append rows in place rather than lead to a new page. Compare page bodies without generated
        # element ids or the changing paging control: both change between reads even when every earlier row remains.
        def body(page: str) -> str:
            return "\n".join(line for line in without_ids(page).splitlines()
                             if not re.match(r'(?:button|link) "', line.strip()))

        bodies = [body(page) for page in pages]
        grows = (len(pages) > 1 and info["tag"].upper() != "A"
                 and all(later.startswith(earlier) and len(later) >= len(earlier)
                         for earlier, later in zip(bodies, bodies[1:])))
        if grows:  # a "load more" control: the last page holds every row
            self.document = pages[-1]
            return (f'followed "{info["name"]}" {len(pages) - 1} time(s); '
                    + ("the rows loaded so far are on the page." + more if capped
                       else "the list is now complete on the page"))
        self.document = "\n".join(f"{PAGE_BREAK} {number} =====\n{page}" for number, page in enumerate(pages, 1))
        return (f'followed "{info["name"]}" through {len(pages)} page(s); you are on the last one.{more} COLLECTED '
                f"DOCUMENT (file it with keep if it is relevant):\n{without_ids(self.document)[:MAX_OBSERVATION * 2]}")

"""What an agent really did on its website, and the gate that reads it before a question is closed.

A model that says "I searched everywhere" proves nothing. The agent loop writes this record itself, from the actions
it carried out: the pages it opened, the text it typed into search and filter fields, the lists it followed and how
each of them ended. Closing a question is then checked against the record:

- a list that stopped at its page limit while its paging control was still there is incomplete, so no question is
  closed on this website until the rest is read;
- "absent" is the one claim the case file cannot check, so it is answered with the record first: a search without
  hits covers that search term in that place and nothing more.

Every refusal is bounded. After `LIMIT` of them a question closes anyway: the gate may cost an agent a few turns,
it must never keep a run from finishing. Nothing here knows a website; where to look next stays the model's call.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from urllib.parse import urlparse

LIMIT = 2  # refusals per question
SHOWN = 12  # entries of each kind in the record an agent is shown


@dataclass
class ListRun:
    where: str  # the address the list was followed from
    control: str  # the label of the paging control
    pages: int
    capped: bool  # it stopped at the page limit and the control was still there


def _short(address: str) -> str:
    """An address without its host: the agent works one website."""
    parts = urlparse(address)
    return (parts.path or "/") + (f"?{parts.query}" if parts.query else "") + (f"#{parts.fragment}" if parts.fragment else "")


class Ledger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.views: dict[str, str] = {}  # address -> title, in the order of the first visit
        self.queries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []  # (address, text typed), each once
        self.lists: list[ListRun] = []
        self.moves = 0  # browser actions that visibly changed the page
        self.refused: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}  # question -> (refusals so far, size of the record at the last)

    # ---- written by the agent loop ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def saw(self, page: str) -> None:
        """A page as the agent read it: its first lines carry the address and the title."""
        address = re.match(r"url: (\S+)", page or "")
        if address and address.group(1) not in self.views:
            title = re.search(r"^title: (.*)$", page, re.M)
            self.views[address.group(1)] = title.group(1).strip()[:60] if title else ""

    def typed(self, where: str, text) -> None:
        text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        if text and (where, text.casefold()) not in {(place, query.casefold()) for place, query in self.queries}:
            self.queries.append((where, text))

    def followed(self, run: dict | None) -> None:
        """How `Tab.collect` ended (its `last_collect`)."""
        if run:
            self.lists.append(ListRun(str(run.get("where", "")), str(run.get("control", "")),
                                      int(run.get("pages") or 0), bool(run.get("capped"))))

    def moved(self) -> None:
        self.moves += 1

    # ---- read by the gate ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def size(self) -> int:
        return len(self.views) + len(self.queries) + len(self.lists) + self.moves

    def incomplete(self) -> list[ListRun]:
        """Lists whose last run stopped at the page limit. Following the same control to its end clears it."""
        latest: dict[str, ListRun] = {}
        for run in self.lists:
            latest[run.control] = run
        return [run for run in latest.values() if run.capped]

    def report(self) -> str:
        pages = [f'"{title}" {_short(address)}' if title else _short(address) for address, title in self.views.items()]
        typed = [f'"{text[:60]}" at {_short(where)}' for where, text in self.queries]
        lists = [f'"{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)}: {run.pages} page(s), '
                 + ("STOPPED AT THE PAGE LIMIT" if run.capped else "to the end") for run in self.lists]
        return "\n".join(f"- {label} ({len(items)}): " + ("; ".join(items[-SHOWN:]) or "none") for label, items in (
            ("pages opened", pages), ("text typed into search and other fields", typed),
            ("lists followed page by page", lists)))

    def gate(self, question: str, status: str) -> str | None:
        """None when the question may be closed as `status`, else what is missing."""
        times, size = self.refused.get(question, (0, -1))
        if times >= LIMIT:
            return None
        cut_short = self.incomplete()
        if cut_short:
            self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
            return ("not closed: " + "; ".join(f'the list you followed with "{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)} '
                                               f"stopped at its limit of {run.pages} page(s) with more pages left"
                                               for run in cut_short)
                    + ". An incomplete list proves neither that everything is filed nor that something is absent. "
                      "Collect the rest (collect continues from the page you are on; a higher max_pages reads "
                      "further), file it with keep, then answer again.")
        if status != "absent" or (times and self.size() > size):
            return None
        self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
        lead = "not closed: nothing new was searched since the last check. " if times else "not closed yet. "
        return (lead + "Absent needs a full search, and this is what you actually did on this website:\n"
                + self.report()
                + "\nA search without hits covers only that search term in that place. Before you answer absent "
                  "again: open every section, folder or list of this website that could hold it and is not in the "
                  "record, search with another term from the case file (an identifier, a shorter form, a "
                  "describing word), and follow paged lists to their end. If the record already covers all of "
                  "that, make one more different search to confirm, then answer again.")
        for frame in self.page.frames:
            try:
                outcome = await frame.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, [self.credentials.get("username", ""), self.credentials["password"]])
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                continue
            if outcome == "ok":
                await frame.locator("[data-login-password]").first.press("Enter")
                await self.settle()
                return f"entered the credentials and submitted the login form; now at {self.page.url}"
        return outcome

    async def collect(self, aid, max_pages: int = 10) -> str:
        """Follow the paging control the model chose until it is gone, and return every page as one document.
        `last_collect` records how it ended: a list that stopped at the page limit with its control still there is
        not complete, and the answer says so instead of passing for the whole list."""
        self.last_collect = None
        locator = self._locator(aid)
        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
        info = await self._describe(locator)
        if not info["name"]:
            return f"[{aid}] has no label to follow from page to page"
        first, start = self.document, self.page.url
        pages, seen = [first], {first}
        limit = max(1, min(int(max_pages or 10), 30))

        async def next_control():
            for _, _, frame in self.frames:
                candidates = frame.locator("a[href], button, [role=button], [role=link]")
                for index in range(min(await candidates.count(), 200)):
                    candidate = candidates.nth(index)
                    try:
                        label = clean_text(await candidate.evaluate("el => el.innerText || el.value || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || ''"))[:80]
                        if label == info["name"] and (await candidate.evaluate("el => el.tagName")) == info["tag"] \
                                and not await candidate.evaluate(
                                    "el => el.disabled === true || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true'"):
                            return candidate
                    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                        continue
            return None

        capped = False
        for turn in range(limit):
            control = await next_control()
            if control is None:
                break
            if turn == limit - 1:  # the page limit ended this, not the list: the control is still there
                capped = True
                break
            try:
                await control.click(timeout=2500)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                try:
                    await control.evaluate("el => el.click()")
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    break
            await self.read()
            if self.document in seen:
                break
            seen.add(self.document)
            pages.append(self.document)
        self.last_collect = {"where": start, "control": info["name"], "pages": len(pages), "capped": capped}
        more = (f' THE LIST IS NOT COMPLETE: this stopped at the limit of {limit} page(s) and "{info["name"]}" is '
                "still there. Collect again from this page (a higher max_pages reads further) before you treat the "
                "list as complete." if capped else "")
        if len(pages) == 1:
            return (f"max_pages {limit} reads only the page you see." + more if capped
                    else f'"{info["name"]}" led to no further page; the list is the page you see')
        # A button may append rows in place rather than lead to a new page. Compare page bodies without generated
        # element ids or the changing paging control: both change between reads even when every earlier row remains.
        def body(page: str) -> str:
            return "\n".join(line for line in without_ids(page).splitlines()
                             if not re.match(r'(?:button|link) "', line.strip()))

        bodies = [body(page) for page in pages]
        grows = (len(pages) > 1 and info["tag"].upper() != "A"
                 and all(later.startswith(earlier) and len(later) >= len(earlier)
                         for earlier, later in zip(bodies, bodies[1:])))
        if grows:  # a "load more" control: the last page holds every row
            self.document = pages[-1]
            return (f'followed "{info["name"]}" {len(pages) - 1} time(s); '
                    + ("the rows loaded so far are on the page." + more if capped
                       else "the list is now complete on the page"))
        self.document = "\n".join(f"{PAGE_BREAK} {number} =====\n{page}" for number, page in enumerate(pages, 1))
        return (f'followed "{info["name"]}" through {len(pages)} page(s); you are on the last one.{more} COLLECTED '
                f"DOCUMENT (file it with keep if it is relevant):\n{without_ids(self.document)[:MAX_OBSERVATION * 2]}")

        """An agent closes a question: its evidence is complete, or the thing does not exist."""
        open_ids = {qid for qid, _ in self.questions()}
        if question not in open_ids:
            return f'"{question}" is not an open question'
        if status not in ("complete", "absent"):
            return 'status must be "complete" or "absent"'

"""What an agent really did on its website, and the gate that reads it before a question is closed.

A model that says "I searched everywhere" proves nothing. The agent loop writes this record itself, from the actions
it carried out: the pages it opened, the text it typed into search and filter fields, the lists it followed and how
each of them ended. Closing a question is then checked against the record:

- a list that stopped at its page limit while its paging control was still there is incomplete, so no question is
  closed on this website until the rest is read;
- "absent" is the one claim the case file cannot check, so it is answered with the record first: a search without
  hits covers that search term in that place and nothing more.

Every refusal is bounded. After `LIMIT` of them a question closes anyway: the gate may cost an agent a few turns,
it must never keep a run from finishing. Nothing here knows a website; where to look next stays the model's call.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from urllib.parse import urlparse

LIMIT = 2  # refusals per question
SHOWN = 12  # entries of each kind in the record an agent is shown


@dataclass
class ListRun:
    where: str  # the address the list was followed from
    control: str  # the label of the paging control
    pages: int
    capped: bool  # it stopped at the page limit and the control was still there


def _short(address: str) -> str:
    """An address without its host: the agent works one website."""
    parts = urlparse(address)
    return (parts.path or "/") + (f"?{parts.query}" if parts.query else "") + (f"#{parts.fragment}" if parts.fragment else "")


class Ledger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.views: dict[str, str] = {}  # address -> title, in the order of the first visit
        self.queries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []  # (address, text typed), each once
        self.lists: list[ListRun] = []
        self.moves = 0  # browser actions that visibly changed the page
        self.refused: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}  # question -> (refusals so far, size of the record at the last)

    # ---- written by the agent loop ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def saw(self, page: str) -> None:
        """A page as the agent read it: its first lines carry the address and the title."""
        address = re.match(r"url: (\S+)", page or "")
        if address and address.group(1) not in self.views:
            title = re.search(r"^title: (.*)$", page, re.M)
            self.views[address.group(1)] = title.group(1).strip()[:60] if title else ""

    def typed(self, where: str, text) -> None:
        text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        if text and (where, text.casefold()) not in {(place, query.casefold()) for place, query in self.queries}:
            self.queries.append((where, text))

    def followed(self, run: dict | None) -> None:
        """How `Tab.collect` ended (its `last_collect`)."""
        if run:
            self.lists.append(ListRun(str(run.get("where", "")), str(run.get("control", "")),
                                      int(run.get("pages") or 0), bool(run.get("capped"))))

    def moved(self) -> None:
        self.moves += 1

    # ---- read by the gate ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def size(self) -> int:
        return len(self.views) + len(self.queries) + len(self.lists) + self.moves

    def incomplete(self) -> list[ListRun]:
        """Lists whose last run stopped at the page limit. Following the same control to its end clears it."""
        latest: dict[str, ListRun] = {}
        for run in self.lists:
            latest[run.control] = run
        return [run for run in latest.values() if run.capped]

    def report(self) -> str:
        pages = [f'"{title}" {_short(address)}' if title else _short(address) for address, title in self.views.items()]
        typed = [f'"{text[:60]}" at {_short(where)}' for where, text in self.queries]
        lists = [f'"{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)}: {run.pages} page(s), '
                 + ("STOPPED AT THE PAGE LIMIT" if run.capped else "to the end") for run in self.lists]
        return "\n".join(f"- {label} ({len(items)}): " + ("; ".join(items[-SHOWN:]) or "none") for label, items in (
            ("pages opened", pages), ("text typed into search and other fields", typed),
            ("lists followed page by page", lists)))

    def gate(self, question: str, status: str) -> str | None:
        """None when the question may be closed as `status`, else what is missing."""
        times, size = self.refused.get(question, (0, -1))
        if times >= LIMIT:
            return None
        cut_short = self.incomplete()
        if cut_short:
            self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
            return ("not closed: " + "; ".join(f'the list you followed with "{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)} '
                                               f"stopped at its limit of {run.pages} page(s) with more pages left"
                                               for run in cut_short)
                    + ". An incomplete list proves neither that everything is filed nor that something is absent. "
                      "Collect the rest (collect continues from the page you are on; a higher max_pages reads "
                      "further), file it with keep, then answer again.")
        if status != "absent" or (times and self.size() > size):
            return None
        self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
        lead = "not closed: nothing new was searched since the last check. " if times else "not closed yet. "
        return (lead + "Absent needs a full search, and this is what you actually did on this website:\n"
                + self.report()
                + "\nA search without hits covers only that search term in that place. Before you answer absent "
                  "again: open every section, folder or list of this website that could hold it and is not in the "
                  "record, search with another term from the case file (an identifier, a shorter form, a "
                  "describing word), and follow paged lists to their end. If the record already covers all of "
                  "that, make one more different search to confirm, then answer again.")
        for frame in self.page.frames:
            try:
                outcome = await frame.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, [self.credentials.get("username", ""), self.credentials["password"]])
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                continue
            if outcome == "ok":
                await frame.locator("[data-login-password]").first.press("Enter")
                await self.settle()
                return f"entered the credentials and submitted the login form; now at {self.page.url}"
        return outcome

    async def collect(self, aid, max_pages: int = 10) -> str:
        """Follow the paging control the model chose until it is gone, and return every page as one document.
        `last_collect` records how it ended: a list that stopped at the page limit with its control still there is
        not complete, and the answer says so instead of passing for the whole list."""
        self.last_collect = None
        locator = self._locator(aid)
        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
        info = await self._describe(locator)
        if not info["name"]:
            return f"[{aid}] has no label to follow from page to page"
        first, start = self.document, self.page.url
        pages, seen = [first], {first}
        limit = max(1, min(int(max_pages or 10), 30))

        async def next_control():
            for _, _, frame in self.frames:
                candidates = frame.locator("a[href], button, [role=button], [role=link]")
                for index in range(min(await candidates.count(), 200)):
                    candidate = candidates.nth(index)
                    try:
                        label = clean_text(await candidate.evaluate("el => el.innerText || el.value || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || ''"))[:80]
                        if label == info["name"] and (await candidate.evaluate("el => el.tagName")) == info["tag"] \
                                and not await candidate.evaluate(
                                    "el => el.disabled === true || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true'"):
                            return candidate
                    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                        continue
            return None

        capped = False
        for turn in range(limit):
            control = await next_control()
            if control is None:
                break
            if turn == limit - 1:  # the page limit ended this, not the list: the control is still there
                capped = True
                break
            try:
                await control.click(timeout=2500)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                try:
                    await control.evaluate("el => el.click()")
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    break
            await self.read()
            if self.document in seen:
                break
            seen.add(self.document)
            pages.append(self.document)
        self.last_collect = {"where": start, "control": info["name"], "pages": len(pages), "capped": capped}
        more = (f' THE LIST IS NOT COMPLETE: this stopped at the limit of {limit} page(s) and "{info["name"]}" is '
                "still there. Collect again from this page (a higher max_pages reads further) before you treat the "
                "list as complete." if capped else "")
        if len(pages) == 1:
            return (f"max_pages {limit} reads only the page you see." + more if capped
                    else f'"{info["name"]}" led to no further page; the list is the page you see')
        # A button may append rows in place rather than lead to a new page. Compare page bodies without generated
        # element ids or the changing paging control: both change between reads even when every earlier row remains.
        def body(page: str) -> str:
            return "\n".join(line for line in without_ids(page).splitlines()
                             if not re.match(r'(?:button|link) "', line.strip()))

        bodies = [body(page) for page in pages]
        grows = (len(pages) > 1 and info["tag"].upper() != "A"
                 and all(later.startswith(earlier) and len(later) >= len(earlier)
                         for earlier, later in zip(bodies, bodies[1:])))
        if grows:  # a "load more" control: the last page holds every row
            self.document = pages[-1]
            return (f'followed "{info["name"]}" {len(pages) - 1} time(s); '
                    + ("the rows loaded so far are on the page." + more if capped
                       else "the list is now complete on the page"))
        self.document = "\n".join(f"{PAGE_BREAK} {number} =====\n{page}" for number, page in enumerate(pages, 1))
        return (f'followed "{info["name"]}" through {len(pages)} page(s); you are on the last one.{more} COLLECTED '
                f"DOCUMENT (file it with keep if it is relevant):\n{without_ids(self.document)[:MAX_OBSERVATION * 2]}")

    async def fetch(self, aid) -> str:
        """Download what the chosen link points to and read it as a document."""
        locator = self._locator(aid)
        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
        target = await locator.evaluate("el => el.href || el.src || el.getAttribute('data-url') || el.getAttribute('formaction') || ''")
        if not target:
            return f"[{aid}] has no address to download"
        target = urljoin(self.page.url, target)
        if not self._on_site(target):
            return f"{target} is not on this website"
        try:
            response = await self.page.context.request.get(target, timeout=20000)
            data = await response.body()
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"could not download {target}: {str(error)[:150]}"
        name = urlparse(target).path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] or "download"
        disposition = response.headers.get("content-disposition", "")
        self.assertIn("[unchecked]", self.control(page, "checkbox", "Send me updates").text)
        self.assertIn("value=4", self.control(page, "slider", "Priority").text)

        self.assertIn("/echo", await tab.click(self.control(page, "button", "Place order").id))
        self.assertEqual(SITE.posted("/echo"), {"customer": "Example Works", "remark": "ring twice", "item": "wb",
                                                "unit": "box", "delivery": "express", "gift": "yes", "priority": "4"})
        self.assertIn("Example Works", await tab.observe())

    async def test_fill_with_enter_sends_a_form_that_has_no_button(self):
        tab = await self.open("/form.html")
        page = await tab.observe()
        await tab.fill(self.control(page, "input", "Find an order").id, "order 17", enter=True)
        self.assertTrue(tab.page.url.endswith("/echo?q=order+17"), tab.page.url)

    async def test_an_element_that_is_gone_is_reported_instead_of_guessed(self):
        tab = await self.open("/form.html")

        for said in (await tab.click(999), await tab.fill(999, "x"), await tab.select(999, "x"), await tab.set(999, 1),

   - **Before starting a feature or debugging:** Search previous sessions, commits, and decisions so context carries over across agents (e.g., from Antigravity to Claude Code or Codex):
     ```bash
     entire search "<query>" --json --compact
     entire checkpoint list
     entire checkpoint explain HEAD
     entire why <file>:<line> --json
     ```
   - **Codebase Navigation (`entire-graph`):** When `entire-graph` is available, use `entire graph` / `entire-graph search` before broad `grep` or full-file reads to locate implementations, trace relationships, and evaluate change impact (saves up to 71% token spend; tracked via `entire graph stats --repo .`).
   - **Cross-Agent Memory (`entire-brain`):** When `entire-brain` is available, consult it for prior architectural decisions, rejected approaches, and cross-agent handoffs.
5. **Trails & Agentic Code Review:**
   - Trail runners are configured in `.entire/runners/`.
   - When working with Trails (`entire trail list`, `entire trail create`, `entire trail show`, `entire trail finding`), keep branch commits clean so Entire Runners (risk, confidence, drift, security, review) can score and review changes automatically.
6. **Self-Healing Diagnostics:**
   - If a session or checkpoint does not appear or hooks look out of sync, run:
     ```bash
     entire status
     entire doctor
     ```

---

## 2. Quick Command Reference for Agents

```bash
# Discover exact CLI capabilities & flags
entire agent-help
entire status

# Inspect & explain checkpoints tied to commits
entire checkpoint list
entire checkpoint explain HEAD
entire checkpoint search "<query>"

# Hybrid semantic + keyword search across sessions, commits, and code
entire search "<query>" --json --compact
entire search --code "<symbol>"

# Trace the commit, checkpoint, prompt, and session behind a file/line
entire why <path/to/file>:<line> --json

# Manage & inspect active agent sessions
entire session current
entire session list
entire session tokens <session-id>

# Trails & Runners (Agentic Code Review)
entire trail list
entire trail create
entire runner setup -y

# Diagnose & fix hook/checkpoint issues
entire doctor
```

---

## 3. Chosen Challenge: Atira — "From RFQ to Bid" (`rfq`)

- **Challenge Platform:** `https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/` (`llms.txt`: `https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/llms.txt`)
- **Atira CLI Path (Windows):** `C:\Users\vamsh\AppData\Local\atira\bin\atira.cmd` (or `atira`)
- **Starter Kit & Agent Package Directory:** `starter-kit/`
- **MCP Server Command:** `atira mcp` (`claude mcp add atira -- atira mcp` / `codex mcp add atira -- atira mcp`)
- **Core Fair-Play Rules (`https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/docs/fair-play.md`):**
  - **NEVER hardcode scenario values** from the public dataset (`VG-2027-7093`, material numbers, prices, discounts, quantities, TANs) into code, prompts, or fallbacks. Every package is inspected by an AI reviewer before running.
  - **Must be genuinely agentic:** An LLM (`Qwen3.8-Flash-Next` / `Cloudflare Clef` or frontier model via proxy) must decide navigation targets, searches, and document selections at runtime. Deterministic Python helpers are allowed and encouraged for DOM extraction of selected pages, pagination, and exact `Decimal` (`ROUND_HALF_UP`) commercial calculations.
  - **At most 4 browsers** via `CDP_URLS` (`"browsers": 4` in `agent.json`). Never launch extra browser processes in the sandbox.
  - **Ranking Order:** `Eligible first -> Quality (0..100) ↓ -> Cost × Time ↑`, evaluated primarily on the **Private Dataset** (same 29 bid rules & answer schema, different website software/layouts/data).

        info = await self._describe(locator)

        first, start = self.document, self.page.url

            if control is None:

            seen.add(self.document)

    async def fetch(self, aid) -> str:
        """Download what the chosen link points to and read it as a document."""
        locator = self._locator(aid)
        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
        target = await locator.evaluate("el => el.href || el.src || el.getAttribute('data-url') || el.getAttribute('formaction') || ''")
        if not target:
            return f"[{aid}] has no address to download"
        target = urljoin(self.page.url, target)
        if not self._on_site(target):
            return f"{target} is not on this website"
        try:
            response = await self.page.context.request.get(target, timeout=20000)
            data = await response.body()
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"could not download {target}: {str(error)[:150]}"
        name = urlparse(target).path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] or "download"
        disposition = response.headers.get("content-disposition", "")
        named = re.search(r'filename\*?=(?:UTF-8\'\')?"?([^";]+)', disposition)
        if named:
            name = named.group(1)
        self.document = document_text(data, response.headers.get("content-type", ""), name)
        self.document_source = target
        return (f"downloaded {name} (HTTP {response.status}, {len(data)} bytes). DOCUMENT (file it with keep if it is "
                f"relevant):\n{self.document[:MAX_OBSERVATION * 2]}")
"""The agent loop: a model reads a browser tab as text, decides what to do next, and acts.

One `Agent` drives one `Tab`. Each turn the model gets its briefing, what its last actions did and the current page,
and answers with a thought and a short list of actions. The loop only carries those out; where to go, what to
search for, which record matters and when the job is finished are the model's calls.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import time
from typing import Awaitable, Callable

import llm
import sanity
from browser_env import NOT_KEPT, Tab
from coverage import Ledger

ACTIONS_HELP = """Reply with ONE JSON object: {"thought": "<one or two short sentences: what the page tells you and what you do next>", "actions": [ ... ]}.
The actions run in order. Once an action loads another page the rest of the list is dropped, because the element
ids change with every page: chain actions only while you stay on the page (fill fields, tick boxes, then click).
Elements you can act on carry an id like [12].

Browser actions:
  {"do": "login"}                                  enter this website's credentials in the login form shown and submit it
  {"do": "click", "id": 12}
  {"do": "fill", "id": 12, "text": "...", "enter": false}     type into a field; "enter": true also presses Enter
  {"do": "select", "id": 12, "value": "<an option's value or label>"}
  {"do": "set", "id": 12, "value": true}           tick/untick a checkbox, choose a radio button, or move a slider to a number
  {"do": "goto", "url": "<an address or path on this website that you have seen>"}
  {"do": "back"}    {"do": "reload"}
  {"do": "collect", "id": 12, "max_pages": 10}     [12] is the next-page or load-more control of a list or paged document you want in full: it is followed until the end and all pages come back as one document
  {"do": "fetch", "id": 12}                        download the file behind link [12] (archive, CSV, PDF, text) and read it as a document
  {"do": "wait"}                                   pause two seconds, for a page that is still loading
  {"do": "done", "summary": "<ten words>", "answer": "..."}   you are finished; "answer" only when you were asked for one

Reading the page:
- It is rendered as a screen reader would read it. "(described: ...)" and "(tooltip: ...)" hold text that only
  shows on hover, "[canvas: ...]" what a drawing says, "(in collapsed menu)" an entry of a menu that is closed
  (you can click it all the same), "->" where a link leads, "{data-...}" attributes of a control.
- A "LOCKED AREA" is disabled until you pass the check in front of it. A page can hold several checks, one per
  area, also inside embedded frames further down: after passing one, look for the next LOCKED AREA and its own
  controls. A check whose status already reads as unlocked is done; setting it again changes nothing.
- A "toggle" opens or closes a section. If a section you opened stays empty after you unlocked it, click its toggle
  twice (close, then open) to load it again.
- Several controls can carry the same name while only one of them does the job: tell them apart by where they
  lead and what their attributes say.
- Popups, cookie walls, access checks, error pages and expired sessions happen. Deal with them and carry on;
  after a session expires, log in again. Surveys, tools and help pages lead away from your task.
"""

STEP_TIMEOUT = 45  # seconds for one page read or one browser action: a hung page must not freeze the whole run
FULL_TURNS = 2  # how many past turns stay word for word; older ones keep the reasoning and drop the page text
NAVIGATING = {"click", "goto", "back", "reload", "login", "collect", "fetch"}


def state_fingerprint(observation: str) -> str:
    """A stable signature of the model-visible page state.

    ``Tab.observe`` assigns fresh action ids on every read.  They are useful to
    the model, but must not make an unchanged page look like a successful
    action.  Removing only those generated ids keeps visible values, errors,
    dialogs and the URL in the comparison.
    """
    stable = re.sub(r"\[\d+\]", "[]", observation)
    return hashlib.sha1(stable.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()


class Agent:
    def __init__(self, name: str, tab: Tab, system: str, briefing: Callable[[], str],
                 extra: dict[str, Callable[[dict], Awaitable[str]]] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None,
                 max_steps: int = 80, think: bool = False,
                 idle: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str | None]] | None = None,
                 guard: Callable[[dict], str | None] | None = None):
        """`briefing()` heads every turn. `extra` adds actions: name -> handler(action) -> result text.
        `idle("done")` lets the caller hold a finished agent until there is news for it (returns the news) or
        let it stop (returns None)."""
        self.name, self.tab, self.system, self.briefing = name, tab, system, briefing
        self.extra = extra or {}
        self.deadline = deadline or time.time() + 3600
        self.max_steps, self.think, self.idle = max_steps, think, idle
        self.guard = guard  # a sanity check that may veto a browser action before it runs (sanity.py)
        self.turns: list[dict] = []
        self.held: tuple[str, str] | None = None  # a collected or fetched document, until the agent moves on
        self.coverage = Ledger()  # what this agent really opened, typed and followed (coverage.py)
        self.steps = 0
        self.started = time.time()

    def document(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """What the agent is looking at: the document it collected or fetched, else the page as last read."""
        return self.held or (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)

    def log(self, text: str) -> None:
        print(f"[{self.name} {self.steps:02d} t+{time.time() - self.started:.0f}s] {text}", flush=True)

    def _messages(self, user: str) -> list[dict]:
        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self.system}]
        for index, turn in enumerate(self.turns):
            recent = index >= len(self.turns) - FULL_TURNS
            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": turn["user"] if recent else turn["short"]})
            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": turn["assistant"]})
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user})
        return messages

    async def _browser(self, action: dict) -> str:
        do, tab = action.get("do"), self.tab
        if do == "login":
            return await tab.login()
        if do == "click":
            return await tab.click(action.get("id"))
        if do == "fill":
            return await tab.fill(action.get("id"), action.get("text", ""), bool(action.get("enter")))
        if do == "select":
            return await tab.select(action.get("id"), action.get("value", ""))
        if do == "set":
            return await tab.set(action.get("id"), action.get("value", True))
        if do == "goto":
            return await tab.goto(action.get("url", ""))
        if do == "back":
            return await tab.back()
        if do == "reload":
            return await tab.reload()
        if do == "collect":
            return await tab.collect(action.get("id"), action.get("max_pages") or 10)
        if do == "fetch":
            return await tab.fetch(action.get("id"))
        return f'unknown action "{do}"'

    def _may_close(self, action: dict) -> str | None:
        """An action that closes a question ({"question": ..., "status": "complete" | "absent"}) is checked against
        what the agent really did on its website, not against what it says it did. None lets the action run."""
        status = str(action.get("status", "")).strip().lower()
        if "question" not in action or status not in ("complete", "absent") or not sanity.enabled("coverage_gate"):
            return None
        return self.coverage.gate(str(action.get("question", "")).strip("[] "), status)

    async def _alive(self) -> bool:

"""The agent loop: a model reads a browser tab as text, decides what to do next, and acts.

One `Agent` drives one `Tab`. Each turn the model gets its briefing, what its last actions did and the current page,
and answers with a thought and a short list of actions. The loop only carries those out; where to go, what to
search for, which record matters and when the job is finished are the model's calls.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import time
from typing import Awaitable, Callable

import llm
import sanity
from browser_env import NOT_KEPT, Tab
from coverage import Ledger

ACTIONS_HELP = """Reply with ONE JSON object: {"thought": "<one or two short sentences: what the page tells you and what you do next>", "actions": [ ... ]}.
The actions run in order. Once an action loads another page the rest of the list is dropped, because the element
ids change with every page: chain actions only while you stay on the page (fill fields, tick boxes, then click).
Elements you can act on carry an id like [12].

Browser actions:
  {"do": "login"}                                  enter this website's credentials in the login form shown and submit it
  {"do": "click", "id": 12}
  {"do": "fill", "id": 12, "text": "...", "enter": false}     type into a field; "enter": true also presses Enter
  {"do": "select", "id": 12, "value": "<an option's value or label>"}
  {"do": "set", "id": 12, "value": true}           tick/untick a checkbox, choose a radio button, or move a slider to a number
  {"do": "goto", "url": "<an address or path on this website that you have seen>"}
  {"do": "back"}    {"do": "reload"}
  {"do": "collect", "id": 12, "max_pages": 10}     [12] is the next-page or load-more control of a list or paged document you want in full: it is followed until the end and all pages come back as one document
  {"do": "fetch", "id": 12}                        download the file behind link [12] (archive, CSV, PDF, text) and read it as a document
  {"do": "wait"}                                   pause two seconds, for a page that is still loading
  {"do": "done", "summary": "<ten words>", "answer": "..."}   you are finished; "answer" only when you were asked for one

Reading the page:
- It is rendered as a screen reader would read it. "(described: ...)" and "(tooltip: ...)" hold text that only
  shows on hover, "[canvas: ...]" what a drawing says, "(in collapsed menu)" an entry of a menu that is closed
  (you can click it all the same), "->" where a link leads, "{data-...}" attributes of a control.
- A "LOCKED AREA" is disabled until you pass the check in front of it. A page can hold several checks, one per
  area, also inside embedded frames further down: after passing one, look for the next LOCKED AREA and its own
  controls. A check whose status already reads as unlocked is done; setting it again changes nothing.
- A "toggle" opens or closes a section. If a section you opened stays empty after you unlocked it, click its toggle
  twice (close, then open) to load it again.
- Several controls can carry the same name while only one of them does the job: tell them apart by where they
  lead and what their attributes say.
- Popups, cookie walls, access checks, error pages and expired sessions happen. Deal with them and carry on;
  after a session expires, log in again. Surveys, tools and help pages lead away from your task.
"""

STEP_TIMEOUT = 45  # seconds for one page read or one browser action: a hung page must not freeze the whole run
FULL_TURNS = 2  # how many past turns stay word for word; older ones keep the reasoning and drop the page text
NAVIGATING = {"click", "goto", "back", "reload", "login", "collect", "fetch"}


def state_fingerprint(observation: str) -> str:
    """A stable signature of the model-visible page state.

    ``Tab.observe`` assigns fresh action ids on every read.  They are useful to
    the model, but must not make an unchanged page look like a successful
    action.  Removing only those generated ids keeps visible values, errors,
    dialogs and the URL in the comparison.
    """
    stable = re.sub(r"\[\d+\]", "[]", observation)
    return hashlib.sha1(stable.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()


class Agent:
    def __init__(self, name: str, tab: Tab, system: str, briefing: Callable[[], str],
                 extra: dict[str, Callable[[dict], Awaitable[str]]] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None,
                 max_steps: int = 80, think: bool = False,
                 idle: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str | None]] | None = None,
                 guard: Callable[[dict], str | None] | None = None):
        """`briefing()` heads every turn. `extra` adds actions: name -> handler(action) -> result text.
        `idle("done")` lets the caller hold a finished agent until there is news for it (returns the news) or
        let it stop (returns None)."""
        self.name, self.tab, self.system, self.briefing = name, tab, system, briefing
        self.extra = extra or {}
        self.deadline = deadline or time.time() + 3600
        self.max_steps, self.think, self.idle = max_steps, think, idle
        self.guard = guard  # a sanity check that may veto a browser action before it runs (sanity.py)
        self.turns: list[dict] = []
        self.held: tuple[str, str] | None = None  # a collected or fetched document, until the agent moves on
        self.coverage = Ledger()  # what this agent really opened, typed and followed (coverage.py)
        self.steps = 0
        self.started = time.time()

    def document(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """What the agent is looking at: the document it collected or fetched, else the page as last read."""
        return self.held or (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)

    def log(self, text: str) -> None:
        print(f"[{self.name} {self.steps:02d} t+{time.time() - self.started:.0f}s] {text}", flush=True)

    def _messages(self, user: str) -> list[dict]:
        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self.system}]
        for index, turn in enumerate(self.turns):
            recent = index >= len(self.turns) - FULL_TURNS
            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": turn["user"] if recent else turn["short"]})
            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": turn["assistant"]})
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user})
        return messages

    async def _browser(self, action: dict) -> str:
        do, tab = action.get("do"), self.tab
        if do == "login":
            return await tab.login()
        if do == "click":
            return await tab.click(action.get("id"))
        if do == "fill":
            return await tab.fill(action.get("id"), action.get("text", ""), bool(action.get("enter")))
        if do == "select":
            return await tab.select(action.get("id"), action.get("value", ""))
        if do == "set":
            return await tab.set(action.get("id"), action.get("value", True))
        if do == "goto":
            return await tab.goto(action.get("url", ""))
        if do == "back":
            return await tab.back()
        if do == "reload":
            return await tab.reload()
        if do == "collect":
            return await tab.collect(action.get("id"), action.get("max_pages") or 10)
        if do == "fetch":
            return await tab.fetch(action.get("id"))
        return f'unknown action "{do}"'

    def _may_close(self, action: dict) -> str | None:
        """An action that closes a question ({"question": ..., "status": "complete" | "absent"}) is checked against
        what the agent really did on its website, not against what it says it did. None lets the action run."""
        status = str(action.get("status", "")).strip().lower()
        if "question" not in action or status not in ("complete", "absent") or not sanity.enabled("coverage_gate"):
            return None
        return self.coverage.gate(str(action.get("question", "")).strip("[] "), status)

    async def _alive(self) -> bool:
        try:
            return bool(await self.tab.page.main_frame.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-aid]').length > 0"))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return False

    async def run(self) -> dict:
        results: list[str] = []
        outcome = {"done": False, "summary": "", "answer": None, "steps": 0}
        self.log(f"starting at {self.tab.base_url}")
        if self.tab.page.url in ("", "about:blank"):
            try:
                results.append(await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.goto(self.tab.base_url + "/"), STEP_TIMEOUT))
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                results.append(f"opening {self.tab.base_url} took longer than {STEP_TIMEOUT} s; reload or try again")
        repeats, last_signature, failures = 0, "", 0

"""The agent loop: a model reads a browser tab as text, decides what to do next, and acts.

One `Agent` drives one `Tab`. Each turn the model gets its briefing, what its last actions did and the current page,
and answers with a thought and a short list of actions. The loop only carries those out; where to go, what to
search for, which record matters and when the job is finished are the model's calls.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import time
from typing import Awaitable, Callable

import llm
import sanity
from browser_env import NOT_KEPT, Tab

ACTIONS_HELP = """Reply with ONE JSON object: {"thought": "<one or two short sentences: what the page tells you and what you do next>", "actions": [ ... ]}.
The actions run in order. Once an action loads another page the rest of the list is dropped, because the element
ids change with every page: chain actions only while you stay on the page (fill fields, tick boxes, then click).
Elements you can act on carry an id like [12].

Browser actions:
  {"do": "login"}                                  enter this website's credentials in the login form shown and submit it
  {"do": "click", "id": 12}
  {"do": "fill", "id": 12, "text": "...", "enter": false}     type into a field; "enter": true also presses Enter
  {"do": "select", "id": 12, "value": "<an option's value or label>"}
  {"do": "set", "id": 12, "value": true}           tick/untick a checkbox, choose a radio button, or move a slider to a number
  {"do": "goto", "url": "<an address or path on this website that you have seen>"}
  {"do": "back"}    {"do": "reload"}
  {"do": "collect", "id": 12, "max_pages": 10}     [12] is the next-page or load-more control of a list or paged document you want in full: it is followed until the end and all pages come back as one document
  {"do": "fetch", "id": 12}                        download the file behind link [12] (archive, CSV, PDF, text) and read it as a document
  {"do": "wait"}                                   pause two seconds, for a page that is still loading
  {"do": "done", "summary": "<ten words>", "answer": "..."}   you are finished; "answer" only when you were asked for one

Reading the page:
- It is rendered as a screen reader would read it. "(described: ...)" and "(tooltip: ...)" hold text that only
  shows on hover, "[canvas: ...]" what a drawing says, "(in collapsed menu)" an entry of a menu that is closed
  (you can click it all the same), "->" where a link leads, "{data-...}" attributes of a control.
- A "LOCKED AREA" is disabled until you pass the check in front of it. A page can hold several checks, one per
  area, also inside embedded frames further down: after passing one, look for the next LOCKED AREA and its own
  controls. A check whose status already reads as unlocked is done; setting it again changes nothing.
- A "toggle" opens or closes a section. If a section you opened stays empty after you unlocked it, click its toggle
  twice (close, then open) to load it again.
- Several controls can carry the same name while only one of them does the job: tell them apart by where they
  lead and what their attributes say.
- Popups, cookie walls, access checks, error pages and expired sessions happen. Deal with them and carry on;
  after a session expires, log in again. Surveys, tools and help pages lead away from your task.

        if do == "fill":

            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
        info = await self._describe(locator)
        if not info["name"]:
            return f"[{aid}] has no label to follow from page to page"
        first, start = self.document, self.page.url
        pages, seen = [first], {first}
        limit = max(1, min(int(max_pages or 10), 30))

                    try:

        """Download what the chosen link points to and read it as a document."""
        locator = self._locator(aid)
        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"

        named = re.search(r'filename\*?=(?:UTF-8\'\')?"?([^";]+)', disposition)
        if named:
