"""The agent loop: a model reads a browser tab as text, decides what to do next, and acts.

One `Agent` drives one `Tab`. Each turn the model gets its briefing, what its last actions did and the current page,
and answers with a thought and a short list of actions. The loop only carries those out; where to go, what to
search for, which record matters and when the job is finished are the model's calls.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import time
from typing import Awaitable, Callable

import llm
import sanity
from browser_env import NOT_KEPT, Tab
from coverage import Ledger

ACTIONS_HELP = """Reply with ONE JSON object: {"thought": "<one or two short sentences: what the page tells you and what you do next>", "actions": [ ... ]}.
The actions run in order. Once an action loads another page the rest of the list is dropped, because the element
ids change with every page: chain actions only while you stay on the page (fill fields, tick boxes, then click).
Elements you can act on carry an id like [12].

Browser actions:
  {"do": "login"}                                  enter this website's credentials in the login form shown and submit it
  {"do": "click", "id": 12}
  {"do": "fill", "id": 12, "text": "...", "enter": false}     type into a field; "enter": true also presses Enter
  {"do": "select", "id": 12, "value": "<an option's value or label>"}
  {"do": "set", "id": 12, "value": true}           tick/untick a checkbox, choose a radio button, or move a slider to a number
  {"do": "goto", "url": "<an address or path on this website that you have seen>"}
  {"do": "back"}    {"do": "reload"}
  {"do": "collect", "id": 12, "max_pages": 10}     [12] is the next-page or load-more control of a list or paged document you want in full: it is followed until the end and all pages come back as one document
  {"do": "fetch", "id": 12}                        download the file behind link [12] (archive, CSV, PDF, text) and read it as a document
  {"do": "wait"}                                   pause two seconds, for a page that is still loading
  {"do": "done", "summary": "<ten words>", "answer": "..."}   you are finished; "answer" only when you were asked for one

Reading the page:
- It is rendered as a screen reader would read it. "(described: ...)" and "(tooltip: ...)" hold text that only
  shows on hover, "[canvas: ...]" what a drawing says, "(in collapsed menu)" an entry of a menu that is closed
  (you can click it all the same), "->" where a link leads, "{data-...}" attributes of a control.
- A "LOCKED AREA" is disabled until you pass the check in front of it. A page can hold several checks, one per
  area, also inside embedded frames further down: after passing one, look for the next LOCKED AREA and its own
  controls. A check whose status already reads as unlocked is done; setting it again changes nothing.
- A "toggle" opens or closes a section. If a section you opened stays empty after you unlocked it, click its toggle
  twice (close, then open) to load it again.
- Several controls can carry the same name while only one of them does the job: tell them apart by where they
  lead and what their attributes say.
- Popups, cookie walls, access checks, error pages and expired sessions happen. Deal with them and carry on;
  after a session expires, log in again. Surveys, tools and help pages lead away from your task.
"""

STEP_TIMEOUT = 45  # seconds for one page read or one browser action: a hung page must not freeze the whole run
FULL_TURNS = 2  # how many past turns stay word for word; older ones keep the reasoning and drop the page text
NAVIGATING = {"click", "goto", "back", "reload", "login", "collect", "fetch"}


def state_fingerprint(observation: str) -> str:
    """A stable signature of the model-visible page state.

    ``Tab.observe`` assigns fresh action ids on every read.  They are useful to
    the model, but must not make an unchanged page look like a successful
    action.  Removing only those generated ids keeps visible values, errors,
    dialogs and the URL in the comparison.
    """
    stable = re.sub(r"\[\d+\]", "[]", observation)
    return hashlib.sha1(stable.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()


class Agent:
    def __init__(self, name: str, tab: Tab, system: str, briefing: Callable[[], str],
                 extra: dict[str, Callable[[dict], Awaitable[str]]] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None,
                 max_steps: int = 80, think: bool = False,
                 idle: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str | None]] | None = None,
                 guard: Callable[[dict], str | None] | None = None):
        """`briefing()` heads every turn. `extra` adds actions: name -> handler(action) -> result text.
        `idle("done")` lets the caller hold a finished agent until there is news for it (returns the news) or
        let it stop (returns None)."""
        self.name, self.tab, self.system, self.briefing = name, tab, system, briefing
        self.extra = extra or {}
        self.deadline = deadline or time.time() + 3600
        self.max_steps, self.think, self.idle = max_steps, think, idle
        self.guard = guard  # a sanity check that may veto a browser action before it runs (sanity.py)
        self.turns: list[dict] = []
        self.held: tuple[str, str] | None = None  # a collected or fetched document, until the agent moves on
        self.coverage = Ledger()  # what this agent really opened, typed and followed (coverage.py)
        self.steps = 0
        self.started = time.time()

    def document(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """What the agent is looking at: the document it collected or fetched, else the page as last read."""
        return self.held or (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)

    def log(self, text: str) -> None:
        print(f"[{self.name} {self.steps:02d} t+{time.time() - self.started:.0f}s] {text}", flush=True)

    def _messages(self, user: str) -> list[dict]:
        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self.system}]
        for index, turn in enumerate(self.turns):
            recent = index >= len(self.turns) - FULL_TURNS
            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": turn["user"] if recent else turn["short"]})
            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": turn["assistant"]})
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user})
        return messages

    async def _browser(self, action: dict) -> str:
        do, tab = action.get("do"), self.tab
        if do == "login":
            return await tab.login()
        if do == "click":
            return await tab.click(action.get("id"))
        if do == "fill":
            return await tab.fill(action.get("id"), action.get("text", ""), bool(action.get("enter")))
        if do == "select":
            return await tab.select(action.get("id"), action.get("value", ""))
        if do == "set":
            return await tab.set(action.get("id"), action.get("value", True))
        if do == "goto":
            return await tab.goto(action.get("url", ""))
        if do == "back":
            return await tab.back()
        if do == "reload":
            return await tab.reload()
        if do == "collect":
            return await tab.collect(action.get("id"), action.get("max_pages") or 10)
        if do == "fetch":
            return await tab.fetch(action.get("id"))
        return f'unknown action "{do}"'

    def _may_close(self, action: dict) -> str | None:
        """An action that closes a question ({"question": ..., "status": "complete" | "absent"}) is checked against
        what the agent really did on its website, not against what it says it did. None lets the action run."""
        status = str(action.get("status", "")).strip().lower()
        if "question" not in action or status not in ("complete", "absent") or not sanity.enabled("coverage_gate"):
            return None
        return self.coverage.gate(str(action.get("question", "")).strip("[] "), status)

    async def _alive(self) -> bool:
        try:
            return bool(await self.tab.page.main_frame.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-aid]').length > 0"))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return False

    async def run(self) -> dict:
        results: list[str] = []
        outcome = {"done": False, "summary": "", "answer": None, "steps": 0}
        self.log(f"starting at {self.tab.base_url}")
        if self.tab.page.url in ("", "about:blank"):
            try:
                results.append(await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.goto(self.tab.base_url + "/"), STEP_TIMEOUT))
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                results.append(f"opening {self.tab.base_url} took longer than {STEP_TIMEOUT} s; reload or try again")
        repeats, last_signature, failures = 0, "", 0

class EvidenceProvenance(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def test_explicit_unit_notation_controls_piece_or_set_classification(self):
        self.assertFalse(casefile._unit_is_set("Stk."))
        self.assertFalse(casefile._unit_is_set("pieces"))
        self.assertTrue(casefile._unit_is_set("Satz"))
        self.assertTrue(casefile._unit_is_set("kits"))
        self.assertIsNone(casefile._unit_is_set(None))
        self.assertIsNone(casefile._unit_is_set("unknown-unit"))

    async def test_successful_extraction_records_its_source_and_typed_result(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def extracted(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": [{"position": "1", "quantity": 4, "requirement_ref": "REQ-1"}]}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", extracted):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position 1: four items", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "abc123")
        [evidence] = facts.evidence
        self.assertEqual((evidence["id"], evidence["kind"], evidence["source"], evidence["agent"]),
                         ("abc123", "positions", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender"))
        self.assertEqual(evidence["extracted"]["positions"][0]["position"], "1")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(facts.dump())["evidence"][0]["source"], "https://portal.example/rfq")

    async def test_schema_gate_drops_only_malformed_records_and_keeps_its_log(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def mixed(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": [{"position": "1", "quantity": 4}, {"quantity": 9}, "not a record"]}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", mixed):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position records", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "mixed")
        self.assertEqual(set(facts.positions), {"1"})
        self.assertIn("dropped 2 malformed", facts.evidence[0]["validation"])
        self.assertIn("dropped 2 malformed", facts.evidence[0]["summary"])

    async def test_schema_gate_rejects_an_invalid_record_list(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def malformed(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": "not a list"}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", malformed):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position records", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "bad")
        self.assertEqual(facts.positions, {})
        self.assertEqual(facts.evidence, [])
        self.assertIn("schema validation rejected", facts.take_news("tender")[0])

    async def test_only_malformed_rows_are_treated_as_no_usable_evidence(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def malformed_rows(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": [{"quantity": 9}]}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", malformed_rows):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position records", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "empty")
        self.assertEqual(facts.evidence, [])
        self.assertIn("no usable records", facts.take_news("tender")[0])

    def test_requirements_filed_before_revisions_are_hidden_until_revisions_are_filed(self):
        """When requirements are filed with a revision tag before the revisions table is filed,
        governing_revision() is None and inputs().requirements hides them; once revisions is filed,
        the previously extracted requirements become active immediately without re-filing."""
        facts = self.make_casefile()
        facts.merge("positions", {"positions": [
            {"position": "01.01", "quantity": 10, "unit": "pcs", "unit_is_set": False, "requirement_ref": "REQ-A1"},
            {"position": "01.05", "quantity": 3, "unit": "sets", "unit_is_set": True, "requirement_ref": "REQ-A5"},
        ]})
        facts.merge("requirements", {
            "revision": "REV-200",
            "requirements": [
                {"requirement_ref": "REQ-A1", "bore_mm": 50, "stroke_mm": 200, "stroke_is_usable_travel": False,
                 "pressure_bar": 160, "mounting": "flange", "certification": "ISO-1", "catalogue_group": "GRP-10"},
                {"requirement_ref": "REQ-A5", "bore_mm": 80, "stroke_mm": 400, "stroke_is_usable_travel": False,
                 "pressure_bar": 250, "mounting": "clevis", "certification": None, "catalogue_group": "GRP-50",
                 "pieces_per_set": 4},
            ],
        })
        # Before revisions are on file, governing_revision() is None and requirements are withheld
        self.assertIsNone(facts.governing_revision())
        self.assertEqual(facts.inputs().requirements, {})
        qids_before = dict(facts.questions())
        self.assertIn("revision", qids_before)
        self.assertNotIn("material:REQ-A1", qids_before)
        self.assertIn("final ? pieces", facts.status())

        # Filing the revision table unlocks the already-stored requirements and set size
        facts.merge("revisions", {"revisions": [
            {"revision": "REV-100", "status": "superseded", "date": "2030-01-10"},
            {"revision": "REV-200", "status": "current", "date": "2030-05-01"},
        ]})
        self.assertEqual(facts.governing_revision(), "REV-200")
        self.assertEqual(set(facts.inputs().requirements), {"REQ-A1", "REQ-A5"})
        self.assertEqual(facts.inputs().requirements["REQ-A5"].pieces_per_set, 4)
        qids_after = dict(facts.questions())
        self.assertNotIn("revision", qids_after)
        self.assertNotIn("requirements", qids_after)
        self.assertIn("material:REQ-A1", qids_after)
        self.assertIn("material:REQ-A5", qids_after)
        self.assertIn("final 12 pieces", facts.status())

class EvidenceProvenance(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def test_explicit_unit_notation_controls_piece_or_set_classification(self):
        self.assertFalse(casefile._unit_is_set("Stk."))
        self.assertFalse(casefile._unit_is_set("pieces"))
        self.assertTrue(casefile._unit_is_set("Satz"))
        self.assertTrue(casefile._unit_is_set("kits"))
        self.assertIsNone(casefile._unit_is_set(None))
        self.assertIsNone(casefile._unit_is_set("unknown-unit"))

    async def test_successful_extraction_records_its_source_and_typed_result(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def extracted(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": [{"position": "1", "quantity": 4, "requirement_ref": "REQ-1"}]}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", extracted):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position 1: four items", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "abc123")
        [evidence] = facts.evidence
        self.assertEqual((evidence["id"], evidence["kind"], evidence["source"], evidence["agent"]),
                         ("abc123", "positions", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender"))
        self.assertEqual(evidence["extracted"]["positions"][0]["position"], "1")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(facts.dump())["evidence"][0]["source"], "https://portal.example/rfq")

    async def test_schema_gate_drops_only_malformed_records_and_keeps_its_log(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def mixed(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": [{"position": "1", "quantity": 4}, {"quantity": 9}, "not a record"]}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", mixed):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position records", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "mixed")
        self.assertEqual(set(facts.positions), {"1"})
        self.assertIn("dropped 2 malformed", facts.evidence[0]["validation"])
        self.assertIn("dropped 2 malformed", facts.evidence[0]["summary"])

    async def test_schema_gate_rejects_an_invalid_record_list(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def malformed(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": "not a list"}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", malformed):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position records", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "bad")
        self.assertEqual(facts.positions, {})
        self.assertEqual(facts.evidence, [])
        self.assertIn("schema validation rejected", facts.take_news("tender")[0])

    async def test_only_malformed_rows_are_treated_as_no_usable_evidence(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def malformed_rows(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": [{"quantity": 9}]}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", malformed_rows):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position records", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "empty")
        self.assertEqual(facts.evidence, [])
        self.assertIn("no usable records", facts.take_news("tender")[0])

    def make_casefile(self) -> casefile.CaseFile:

    def test_requirements_filed_before_revisions_are_hidden_until_revisions_are_filed(self):
        """When requirements are filed with a revision tag before the revisions table is filed,
        governing_revision() is None and inputs().requirements hides them; once revisions is filed,
        the previously extracted requirements become active immediately without re-filing."""
        facts = self.make_casefile()
        facts.merge("positions", {"positions": [
            {"position": "01.01", "quantity": 10, "unit": "pcs", "unit_is_set": False, "requirement_ref": "REQ-A1"},
            {"position": "01.05", "quantity": 3, "unit": "sets", "unit_is_set": True, "requirement_ref": "REQ-A5"},
        ]})
        facts.merge("requirements", {
            "revision": "REV-200",
            "requirements": [
                {"requirement_ref": "REQ-A1", "bore_mm": 50, "stroke_mm": 200, "stroke_is_usable_travel": False,
                 "pressure_bar": 160, "mounting": "flange", "certification": "ISO-1", "catalogue_group": "GRP-10"},
                {"requirement_ref": "REQ-A5", "bore_mm": 80, "stroke_mm": 400, "stroke_is_usable_travel": False,
                 "pressure_bar": 250, "mounting": "clevis", "certification": None, "catalogue_group": "GRP-50",
                 "pieces_per_set": 4},
            ],
        })
        # Before revisions are on file, governing_revision() is None and requirements are withheld
        self.assertIsNone(facts.governing_revision())
        self.assertEqual(facts.inputs().requirements, {})
        qids_before = dict(facts.questions())
        self.assertIn("revision", qids_before)
        self.assertNotIn("material:REQ-A1", qids_before)
        self.assertIn("final ? pieces", facts.status())

        # Filing the revision table unlocks the already-stored requirements and set size
        facts.merge("revisions", {"revisions": [
            {"revision": "REV-100", "status": "superseded", "date": "2030-01-10"},
            {"revision": "REV-200", "status": "current", "date": "2030-05-01"},
        ]})
        self.assertEqual(facts.governing_revision(), "REV-200")
        self.assertEqual(set(facts.inputs().requirements), {"REQ-A1", "REQ-A5"})
        self.assertEqual(facts.inputs().requirements["REQ-A5"].pieces_per_set, 4)
        qids_after = dict(facts.questions())
        self.assertNotIn("revision", qids_after)
        self.assertNotIn("requirements", qids_after)
        self.assertIn("material:REQ-A1", qids_after)
        self.assertIn("material:REQ-A5", qids_after)
        self.assertIn("final 12 pieces", facts.status())

class EvidenceProvenance(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def test_explicit_unit_notation_controls_piece_or_set_classification(self):
        self.assertFalse(casefile._unit_is_set("Stk."))
        self.assertFalse(casefile._unit_is_set("pieces"))
        self.assertTrue(casefile._unit_is_set("Satz"))
        self.assertTrue(casefile._unit_is_set("kits"))
        self.assertIsNone(casefile._unit_is_set(None))
        self.assertIsNone(casefile._unit_is_set("unknown-unit"))

    async def test_successful_extraction_records_its_source_and_typed_result(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def extracted(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": [{"position": "1", "quantity": 4, "requirement_ref": "REQ-1"}]}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", extracted):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position 1: four items", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "abc123")
        [evidence] = facts.evidence
        self.assertEqual((evidence["id"], evidence["kind"], evidence["source"], evidence["agent"]),
                         ("abc123", "positions", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender"))
        self.assertEqual(evidence["extracted"]["positions"][0]["position"], "1")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(facts.dump())["evidence"][0]["source"], "https://portal.example/rfq")

    async def test_schema_gate_drops_only_malformed_records_and_keeps_its_log(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def mixed(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": [{"position": "1", "quantity": 4}, {"quantity": 9}, "not a record"]}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", mixed):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position records", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "mixed")
        self.assertEqual(set(facts.positions), {"1"})
        self.assertIn("dropped 2 malformed", facts.evidence[0]["validation"])
        self.assertIn("dropped 2 malformed", facts.evidence[0]["summary"])

    async def test_schema_gate_rejects_an_invalid_record_list(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def malformed(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": "not a list"}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", malformed):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position records", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "bad")
        self.assertEqual(facts.positions, {})
        self.assertEqual(facts.evidence, [])
        self.assertIn("schema validation rejected", facts.take_news("tender")[0])

    async def test_only_malformed_rows_are_treated_as_no_usable_evidence(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def malformed_rows(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": [{"quantity": 9}]}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", malformed_rows):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position records", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "empty")
        self.assertEqual(facts.evidence, [])
        self.assertIn("no usable records", facts.take_news("tender")[0])

    def make_casefile(self) -> casefile.CaseFile:

    def test_requirements_filed_before_revisions_are_hidden_until_revisions_are_filed(self):
        """When requirements are filed with a revision tag before the revisions table is filed,
        governing_revision() is None and inputs().requirements hides them; once revisions is filed,
        the previously extracted requirements become active immediately without re-filing."""
        facts = self.make_casefile()
        facts.merge("positions", {"positions": [
            {"position": "01.01", "quantity": 10, "unit": "pcs", "unit_is_set": False, "requirement_ref": "REQ-A1"},
            {"position": "01.05", "quantity": 3, "unit": "sets", "unit_is_set": True, "requirement_ref": "REQ-A5"},
        ]})
        facts.merge("requirements", {
            "revision": "REV-200",
            "requirements": [
                {"requirement_ref": "REQ-A1", "bore_mm": 50, "stroke_mm": 200, "stroke_is_usable_travel": False,
                 "pressure_bar": 160, "mounting": "flange", "certification": "ISO-1", "catalogue_group": "GRP-10"},
                {"requirement_ref": "REQ-A5", "bore_mm": 80, "stroke_mm": 400, "stroke_is_usable_travel": False,
                 "pressure_bar": 250, "mounting": "clevis", "certification": None, "catalogue_group": "GRP-50",
                 "pieces_per_set": 4},
            ],
        })
        # Before revisions are on file, governing_revision() is None and requirements are withheld
        self.assertIsNone(facts.governing_revision())
        self.assertEqual(facts.inputs().requirements, {})
        qids_before = dict(facts.questions())
        self.assertIn("revision", qids_before)
        self.assertNotIn("material:REQ-A1", qids_before)
        self.assertIn("final ? pieces", facts.status())

        # Filing the revision table unlocks the already-stored requirements and set size
        facts.merge("revisions", {"revisions": [
            {"revision": "REV-100", "status": "superseded", "date": "2030-01-10"},
            {"revision": "REV-200", "status": "current", "date": "2030-05-01"},
        ]})
        self.assertEqual(facts.governing_revision(), "REV-200")
        self.assertEqual(set(facts.inputs().requirements), {"REQ-A1", "REQ-A5"})
        self.assertEqual(facts.inputs().requirements["REQ-A5"].pieces_per_set, 4)
        qids_after = dict(facts.questions())
        self.assertNotIn("revision", qids_after)
        self.assertNotIn("requirements", qids_after)
        self.assertIn("material:REQ-A1", qids_after)
        self.assertIn("material:REQ-A5", qids_after)
        self.assertIn("final 12 pieces", facts.status())

class EvidenceProvenance(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def test_explicit_unit_notation_controls_piece_or_set_classification(self):
        self.assertFalse(casefile._unit_is_set("Stk."))
        self.assertFalse(casefile._unit_is_set("pieces"))
        self.assertTrue(casefile._unit_is_set("Satz"))
        self.assertTrue(casefile._unit_is_set("kits"))
        self.assertIsNone(casefile._unit_is_set(None))
        self.assertIsNone(casefile._unit_is_set("unknown-unit"))

    async def test_successful_extraction_records_its_source_and_typed_result(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def extracted(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": [{"position": "1", "quantity": 4, "requirement_ref": "REQ-1"}]}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", extracted):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position 1: four items", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "abc123")
        [evidence] = facts.evidence
        self.assertEqual((evidence["id"], evidence["kind"], evidence["source"], evidence["agent"]),
                         ("abc123", "positions", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender"))
        self.assertEqual(evidence["extracted"]["positions"][0]["position"], "1")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(facts.dump())["evidence"][0]["source"], "https://portal.example/rfq")

    async def test_schema_gate_drops_only_malformed_records_and_keeps_its_log(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def mixed(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": [{"position": "1", "quantity": 4}, {"quantity": 9}, "not a record"]}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", mixed):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position records", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "mixed")
        self.assertEqual(set(facts.positions), {"1"})
        self.assertIn("dropped 2 malformed", facts.evidence[0]["validation"])
        self.assertIn("dropped 2 malformed", facts.evidence[0]["summary"])

    async def test_schema_gate_rejects_an_invalid_record_list(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def malformed(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": "not a list"}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", malformed):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position records", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "bad")
        self.assertEqual(facts.positions, {})
        self.assertEqual(facts.evidence, [])
        self.assertIn("schema validation rejected", facts.take_news("tender")[0])

    async def test_only_malformed_rows_are_treated_as_no_usable_evidence(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def malformed_rows(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": [{"quantity": 9}]}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", malformed_rows):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position records", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "empty")
        self.assertEqual(facts.evidence, [])
        self.assertIn("no usable records", facts.take_news("tender")[0])

    def test_requirements_filed_before_revisions_are_hidden_until_revisions_are_filed(self):
        """When requirements are filed with a revision tag before the revisions table is filed,
        governing_revision() is None and inputs().requirements hides them; once revisions is filed,
        the previously extracted requirements become active immediately without re-filing."""
        facts = self.make_casefile()
        facts.merge("positions", {"positions": [
            {"position": "01.01", "quantity": 10, "unit": "pcs", "unit_is_set": False, "requirement_ref": "REQ-A1"},
            {"position": "01.05", "quantity": 3, "unit": "sets", "unit_is_set": True, "requirement_ref": "REQ-A5"},
        ]})

                {"requirement_ref": "REQ-A5", "bore_mm": 80, "stroke_mm": 400, "stroke_is_usable_travel": False,
                 "pressure_bar": 250, "mounting": "clevis", "certification": None, "catalogue_group": "GRP-50",
                 "pieces_per_set": 4},
            ],
        })
        # Before revisions are on file, governing_revision() is None and requirements are withheld
        self.assertIsNone(facts.governing_revision())
        self.assertEqual(facts.inputs().requirements, {})
        qids_before = dict(facts.questions())
        self.assertIn("revision", qids_before)
        self.assertNotIn("material:REQ-A1", qids_before)
        self.assertIn("final ? pieces", facts.status())

        # Filing the revision table unlocks the already-stored requirements and set size
        facts.merge("revisions", {"revisions": [
            {"revision": "REV-100", "status": "superseded", "date": "2030-01-10"},
            {"revision": "REV-200", "status": "current", "date": "2030-05-01"},
        ]})
        self.assertEqual(facts.governing_revision(), "REV-200")
        self.assertEqual(set(facts.inputs().requirements), {"REQ-A1", "REQ-A5"})
        self.assertEqual(facts.inputs().requirements["REQ-A5"].pieces_per_set, 4)
        qids_after = dict(facts.questions())
        self.assertNotIn("revision", qids_after)
        self.assertNotIn("requirements", qids_after)
        self.assertIn("material:REQ-A1", qids_after)
        self.assertIn("material:REQ-A5", qids_after)

    async def keep(action: dict) -> str:
        document, source = agent.document()
        res = case.file(str(action.get("kind", "")), document, source, name)
        if res.startswith("this document is already filed"):
            res += "; do not file this same page again — check OPEN QUESTIONS for what is missing on another page, or finish with done"
        return res

    async def answer(action: dict) -> str:
        # A completion action can arrive in the same turn as `keep`. Wait for this agent's own
        # extraction result (up to 45 s) instead of blocking on slow extractions from other websites.
        wait_until = min(deadline, time.time() + 45.0)
        while case.pending_for(name) and time.time() < wait_until:
            version = case.version
            if case.pending_for(name):
                await case.wait_change(version, min(1.0, max(0.0, wait_until - time.time())))
        if case.pending_for(name):
            return "Evidence extraction is still pending and the investigation deadline is near; do not repeat this answer action."
        return case.answer(str(action.get("question", "")).strip("[] "), str(action.get("status", "")), str(action.get("note", "")), agent=name)

    # Navigation runs without the model's thinking: about twice as fast. The facts themselves are read by the
    # extraction calls in casefile.py, which keep thinking on. AGENT_THINK=1 turns it back on for comparison.
    agent = Agent(name, tab, system, briefing, extra={"keep": keep, "answer": answer}, deadline=deadline,
                  max_steps=int(os.environ.get("AGENT_MAX_STEPS", "150")), idle=team.hook(name),
                  think=os.environ.get("AGENT_THINK") == "1")
    return agent


async def open_tabs(playwright, sites: list[dict]) -> tuple[list, dict[str, Tab]]:

"""What an agent really did on its website, and the gate that reads it before a question is closed.

A model that says "I searched everywhere" proves nothing. The agent loop writes this record itself, from the actions
it carried out: the pages it opened, the text it typed into search and filter fields, the lists it followed and how
each of them ended. Closing a question is then checked against the record:

- a list that stopped at its page limit while its paging control was still there is incomplete, so no question is
  closed on this website until the rest is read;
- "absent" is the one claim the case file cannot check, so it is answered with the record first: a search without
  hits covers that search term in that place and nothing more.

Every refusal is bounded. After `LIMIT` of them a question closes anyway: the gate may cost an agent a few turns,
it must never keep a run from finishing. Nothing here knows a website; where to look next stays the model's call.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from urllib.parse import urlparse

LIMIT = 2  # refusals per question
SHOWN = 12  # entries of each kind in the record an agent is shown


@dataclass
class ListRun:
    where: str  # the address the list was followed from
    control: str  # the label of the paging control
    pages: int
    capped: bool  # it stopped at the page limit and the control was still there


def _short(address: str) -> str:
    """An address without its host: the agent works one website."""
    parts = urlparse(address)
    return (parts.path or "/") + (f"?{parts.query}" if parts.query else "") + (f"#{parts.fragment}" if parts.fragment else "")


class Ledger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.views: dict[str, str] = {}  # address -> title, in the order of the first visit
        self.queries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []  # (address, text typed), each once
        self.lists: list[ListRun] = []
        self.moves = 0  # browser actions that visibly changed the page
        self.refused: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}  # question -> (refusals so far, size of the record at the last)

    # ---- written by the agent loop ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def saw(self, page: str) -> None:
        """A page as the agent read it: its first lines carry the address and the title."""
        address = re.match(r"url: (\S+)", page or "")
        if address and address.group(1) not in self.views:
            title = re.search(r"^title: (.*)$", page, re.M)
            self.views[address.group(1)] = title.group(1).strip()[:60] if title else ""

    def typed(self, where: str, text) -> None:
        text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        if text and (where, text.casefold()) not in {(place, query.casefold()) for place, query in self.queries}:
            self.queries.append((where, text))

    def followed(self, run: dict | None) -> None:
        """How `Tab.collect` ended (its `last_collect`)."""
        if run:
            self.lists.append(ListRun(str(run.get("where", "")), str(run.get("control", "")),
                                      int(run.get("pages") or 0), bool(run.get("capped"))))

    def moved(self) -> None:
        self.moves += 1

    # ---- read by the gate ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def size(self) -> int:
        return len(self.views) + len(self.queries) + len(self.lists) + self.moves

    def incomplete(self) -> list[ListRun]:
        """Lists whose last run stopped at the page limit. Following the same control to its end clears it."""
        latest: dict[str, ListRun] = {}
        for run in self.lists:
            latest[run.control] = run
        return [run for run in latest.values() if run.capped]

    def report(self) -> str:
        pages = [f'"{title}" {_short(address)}' if title else _short(address) for address, title in self.views.items()]
        typed = [f'"{text[:60]}" at {_short(where)}' for where, text in self.queries]
        lists = [f'"{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)}: {run.pages} page(s), '
                 + ("STOPPED AT THE PAGE LIMIT" if run.capped else "to the end") for run in self.lists]
        return "\n".join(f"- {label} ({len(items)}): " + ("; ".join(items[-SHOWN:]) or "none") for label, items in (
            ("pages opened", pages), ("text typed into search and other fields", typed),
            ("lists followed page by page", lists)))

        return (lead + "Absent needs a full search, and this is what you actually did on this website:\n"
                + self.report()
                + "\nA search without hits covers only that search term in that place. Before you answer absent "
                  "again: open every section, folder or list of this website that could hold it and is not in the "
                  "record, search with another term from the case file (an identifier, a shorter form, a "

"""What an agent really did on its website, and the gate that reads it before a question is closed.

A model that says "I searched everywhere" proves nothing. The agent loop writes this record itself, from the actions
it carried out: the pages it opened, the text it typed into search and filter fields, the lists it followed and how
each of them ended. Closing a question is then checked against the record:

- a list that stopped at its page limit while its paging control was still there is incomplete, so no question is
  closed on this website until the rest is read;
- "absent" is the one claim the case file cannot check, so it is answered with the record first: a search without
  hits covers that search term in that place and nothing more.

Every refusal is bounded. After `LIMIT` of them a question closes anyway: the gate may cost an agent a few turns,
it must never keep a run from finishing. Nothing here knows a website; where to look next stays the model's call.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from urllib.parse import urlparse

LIMIT = 2  # refusals per question
SHOWN = 12  # entries of each kind in the record an agent is shown


@dataclass
class ListRun:
    where: str  # the address the list was followed from
    control: str  # the label of the paging control
    pages: int
    capped: bool  # it stopped at the page limit and the control was still there


def _short(address: str) -> str:
    """An address without its host: the agent works one website."""
    parts = urlparse(address)
    return (parts.path or "/") + (f"?{parts.query}" if parts.query else "") + (f"#{parts.fragment}" if parts.fragment else "")


class Ledger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.views: dict[str, str] = {}  # address -> title, in the order of the first visit
        self.queries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []  # (address, text typed), each once
        self.lists: list[ListRun] = []
        self.moves = 0  # browser actions that visibly changed the page
        self.refused: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}  # question -> (refusals so far, size of the record at the last)

    # ---- written by the agent loop ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def saw(self, page: str) -> None:
        """A page as the agent read it: its first lines carry the address and the title."""
        address = re.match(r"url: (\S+)", page or "")
        if address and address.group(1) not in self.views:
            title = re.search(r"^title: (.*)$", page, re.M)
            self.views[address.group(1)] = title.group(1).strip()[:60] if title else ""

    def typed(self, where: str, text) -> None:
        text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        if text and (where, text.casefold()) not in {(place, query.casefold()) for place, query in self.queries}:
            self.queries.append((where, text))

    def followed(self, run: dict | None) -> None:
        """How `Tab.collect` ended (its `last_collect`)."""
        if run:
            self.lists.append(ListRun(str(run.get("where", "")), str(run.get("control", "")),
                                      int(run.get("pages") or 0), bool(run.get("capped"))))

    def moved(self) -> None:
        self.moves += 1

    # ---- read by the gate ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def size(self) -> int:
        return len(self.views) + len(self.queries) + len(self.lists) + self.moves

    def incomplete(self) -> list[ListRun]:
        """Lists whose last run stopped at the page limit. Following the same control to its end clears it."""
        latest: dict[str, ListRun] = {}
        for run in self.lists:
            latest[run.control] = run
        return [run for run in latest.values() if run.capped]

    def report(self) -> str:
        pages = [f'"{title}" {_short(address)}' if title else _short(address) for address, title in self.views.items()]
        typed = [f'"{text[:60]}" at {_short(where)}' for where, text in self.queries]
        lists = [f'"{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)}: {run.pages} page(s), '
                 + ("STOPPED AT THE PAGE LIMIT" if run.capped else "to the end") for run in self.lists]
        return "\n".join(f"- {label} ({len(items)}): " + ("; ".join(items[-SHOWN:]) or "none") for label, items in (
            ("pages opened", pages), ("text typed into search and other fields", typed),
            ("lists followed page by page", lists)))

        return (lead + "Absent needs a full search, and this is what you actually did on this website:\n"

    """One tab per website: a browser each while the run has enough of them, else further tabs in the last one."""
    count = max(1, len(browsers.cdp_urls()) or min(len(sites), 4))
    opened, tabs, pages = [], {}, []

        opened.append(browser)

    for index, site in enumerate(sites):

"""What an agent really did on its website, and the gate that reads it before a question is closed.

A model that says "I searched everywhere" proves nothing. The agent loop writes this record itself, from the actions
it carried out: the pages it opened, the text it typed into search and filter fields, the lists it followed and how
each of them ended. Closing a question is then checked against the record:

- a list that stopped at its page limit while its paging control was still there is incomplete, so no question is
  closed on this website until the rest is read;
- "absent" is the one claim the case file cannot check, so it is answered with the record first: a search without
  hits covers that search term in that place and nothing more.

Every refusal is bounded. After `LIMIT` of them a question closes anyway: the gate may cost an agent a few turns,
it must never keep a run from finishing. Nothing here knows a website; where to look next stays the model's call.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from urllib.parse import urlparse

LIMIT = 2  # refusals per question
SHOWN = 12  # entries of each kind in the record an agent is shown


@dataclass
class ListRun:
    where: str  # the address the list was followed from
    control: str  # the label of the paging control
    pages: int
    capped: bool  # it stopped at the page limit and the control was still there


def _short(address: str) -> str:
    """An address without its host: the agent works one website."""
    parts = urlparse(address)
    return (parts.path or "/") + (f"?{parts.query}" if parts.query else "") + (f"#{parts.fragment}" if parts.fragment else "")


class Ledger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.views: dict[str, str] = {}  # address -> title, in the order of the first visit
        self.queries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []  # (address, text typed), each once
        self.lists: list[ListRun] = []
        self.moves = 0  # browser actions that visibly changed the page
        self.refused: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}  # question -> (refusals so far, size of the record at the last)

    # ---- written by the agent loop ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def saw(self, page: str) -> None:
        """A page as the agent read it: its first lines carry the address and the title."""
        address = re.match(r"url: (\S+)", page or "")
        if address and address.group(1) not in self.views:
            title = re.search(r"^title: (.*)$", page, re.M)
            self.views[address.group(1)] = title.group(1).strip()[:60] if title else ""

    def typed(self, where: str, text) -> None:
        text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        if text and (where, text.casefold()) not in {(place, query.casefold()) for place, query in self.queries}:
            self.queries.append((where, text))

    def followed(self, run: dict | None) -> None:
        """How `Tab.collect` ended (its `last_collect`)."""
        if run:
            self.lists.append(ListRun(str(run.get("where", "")), str(run.get("control", "")),
                                      int(run.get("pages") or 0), bool(run.get("capped"))))

    def moved(self) -> None:
        self.moves += 1

    # ---- read by the gate ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def size(self) -> int:
        return len(self.views) + len(self.queries) + len(self.lists) + self.moves

    def incomplete(self) -> list[ListRun]:
        """Lists whose last run stopped at the page limit. Following the same control to its end clears it."""
        latest: dict[str, ListRun] = {}
        for run in self.lists:
            latest[run.control] = run
        return [run for run in latest.values() if run.capped]

    def report(self) -> str:
        pages = [f'"{title}" {_short(address)}' if title else _short(address) for address, title in self.views.items()]
        typed = [f'"{text[:60]}" at {_short(where)}' for where, text in self.queries]
        lists = [f'"{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)}: {run.pages} page(s), '
                 + ("STOPPED AT THE PAGE LIMIT" if run.capped else "to the end") for run in self.lists]
        return "\n".join(f"- {label} ({len(items)}): " + ("; ".join(items[-SHOWN:]) or "none") for label, items in (
            ("pages opened", pages), ("text typed into search and other fields", typed),
            ("lists followed page by page", lists)))

    def gate(self, question: str, status: str) -> str | None:
        """None when the question may be closed as `status`, else what is missing."""
        times, size = self.refused.get(question, (0, -1))
        if times >= LIMIT:
            return None
        cut_short = self.incomplete()
        if cut_short:
            self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
            return ("not closed: " + "; ".join(f'the list you followed with "{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)} '
                                               f"stopped at its limit of {run.pages} page(s) with more pages left"
                                               for run in cut_short)
                    + ". An incomplete list proves neither that everything is filed nor that something is absent. "
                      "Collect the rest (collect continues from the page you are on; a higher max_pages reads "
                      "further), file it with keep, then answer again.")
        if status != "absent" or (times and self.size() > size):
            return None
        self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
        lead = "not closed: nothing new was searched since the last check. " if times else "not closed yet. "
        return (lead + "Absent needs a full search, and this is what you actually did on this website:\n"
                + self.report()
                + "\nA search without hits covers only that search term in that place. Before you answer absent "
                  "again: open every section, folder or list of this website that could hold it and is not in the "
                  "record, search with another term from the case file (an identifier, a shorter form, a "
                  "describing word), and follow paged lists to their end. If the record already covers all of "
                  "that, make one more different search to confirm, then answer again.")

"""What an agent really did on its website, and the gate that reads it before a question is closed.

A model that says "I searched everywhere" proves nothing. The agent loop writes this record itself, from the actions
it carried out: the pages it opened, the text it typed into search and filter fields, the lists it followed and how
each of them ended. Closing a question is then checked against the record:

- a list that stopped at its page limit while its paging control was still there is incomplete, so no question is
  closed on this website until the rest is read;
- "absent" is the one claim the case file cannot check, so it is answered with the record first: a search without
  hits covers that search term in that place and nothing more.

Every refusal is bounded. After `LIMIT` of them a question closes anyway: the gate may cost an agent a few turns,
it must never keep a run from finishing. Nothing here knows a website; where to look next stays the model's call.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from urllib.parse import urlparse

LIMIT = 2  # refusals per question
SHOWN = 12  # entries of each kind in the record an agent is shown


@dataclass
class ListRun:
    where: str  # the address the list was followed from
    control: str  # the label of the paging control
    pages: int
    capped: bool  # it stopped at the page limit and the control was still there


def _short(address: str) -> str:
    """An address without its host: the agent works one website."""
    parts = urlparse(address)
    return (parts.path or "/") + (f"?{parts.query}" if parts.query else "") + (f"#{parts.fragment}" if parts.fragment else "")


class Ledger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.views: dict[str, str] = {}  # address -> title, in the order of the first visit
        self.queries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []  # (address, text typed), each once
        self.lists: list[ListRun] = []
        self.moves = 0  # browser actions that visibly changed the page
        self.refused: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}  # question -> (refusals so far, size of the record at the last)

    # ---- written by the agent loop ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def saw(self, page: str) -> None:
        """A page as the agent read it: its first lines carry the address and the title."""
        address = re.match(r"url: (\S+)", page or "")
        if address and address.group(1) not in self.views:
            title = re.search(r"^title: (.*)$", page, re.M)
            self.views[address.group(1)] = title.group(1).strip()[:60] if title else ""

    def typed(self, where: str, text) -> None:
        text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        if text and (where, text.casefold()) not in {(place, query.casefold()) for place, query in self.queries}:
            self.queries.append((where, text))

    def followed(self, run: dict | None) -> None:
        """How `Tab.collect` ended (its `last_collect`)."""
        if run:
            self.lists.append(ListRun(str(run.get("where", "")), str(run.get("control", "")),
                                      int(run.get("pages") or 0), bool(run.get("capped"))))

    def moved(self) -> None:
        self.moves += 1

    # ---- read by the gate ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def size(self) -> int:
        return len(self.views) + len(self.queries) + len(self.lists) + self.moves

    def incomplete(self) -> list[ListRun]:
        """Lists whose last run stopped at the page limit. Following the same control to its end clears it."""
        latest: dict[str, ListRun] = {}
        for run in self.lists:
            latest[run.control] = run
        return [run for run in latest.values() if run.capped]

    def report(self) -> str:
        pages = [f'"{title}" {_short(address)}' if title else _short(address) for address, title in self.views.items()]
        typed = [f'"{text[:60]}" at {_short(where)}' for where, text in self.queries]
        lists = [f'"{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)}: {run.pages} page(s), '
                 + ("STOPPED AT THE PAGE LIMIT" if run.capped else "to the end") for run in self.lists]
        return "\n".join(f"- {label} ({len(items)}): " + ("; ".join(items[-SHOWN:]) or "none") for label, items in (
            ("pages opened", pages), ("text typed into search and other fields", typed),
            ("lists followed page by page", lists)))

    def gate(self, question: str, status: str) -> str | None:
        """None when the question may be closed as `status`, else what is missing."""
        times, size = self.refused.get(question, (0, -1))
        if times >= LIMIT:
            return None
        cut_short = self.incomplete()
        if cut_short:
            self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
            return ("not closed: " + "; ".join(f'the list you followed with "{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)} '
                                               f"stopped at its limit of {run.pages} page(s) with more pages left"
                                               for run in cut_short)
                    + ". An incomplete list proves neither that everything is filed nor that something is absent. "
                      "Collect the rest (collect continues from the page you are on; a higher max_pages reads "
                      "further), file it with keep, then answer again.")
        if status != "absent" or (times and self.size() > size):
            return None
        self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
        lead = "not closed: nothing new was searched since the last check. " if times else "not closed yet. "
        return (lead + "Absent needs a full search, and this is what you actually did on this website:\n"
                + self.report()
                + "\nA search without hits covers only that search term in that place. Before you answer absent "
                  "again: open every section, folder or list of this website that could hold it and is not in the "
                  "record, search with another term from the case file (an identifier, a shorter form, a "
                  "describing word), and follow paged lists to their end. If the record already covers all of "
                  "that, make one more different search to confirm, then answer again.")

Implemented and pushed `d72deb8` to `origin/main`.

- Candidate searches now default to 30 pages and continue in batches when capped.
- Added a required ERP candidate audit: it remains open even after one material matches, and rejects completion when any filed candidate lacks status or technical data.
- The agent is explicitly instructed to collect every result page and inspect every returned material before treating the selection as complete.
- Added regression tests for pagination defaults, invalid page limits, candidate completeness, and no-candidate handling.

Validation: 45 casefile/coverage/worker tests and 7 pagination tests pass after rebasing onto the latest team changes.
